name: Codeg
subtitle: codeg 多智能体编码服务器的 iOS 客户端
localizedDescription:
Codeg for iOS —— codeg 多智能体编码服务器的原生客户端（iPhone / iPad）。

管理服务器、浏览会话、阅读完整对话记录（Markdown、推理过程、工具调用），并实时接收 Agent 的流式回复。

本构建为未签名 IPA，由 GitHub Actions 从 tag 自动构建，需要 TrollStore 安装。

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Codeg connects to your codeg server, which may run on your local network.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Codeg attaches photos you pick to your message to the agent.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Codeg uses the camera to take photos for your messages and to scan a server's QR code.
